hotel.name: The Langley, A Luxury Collection Hotel

verified_facts.text: The hotel is set in the former manor home of the third Duke of Marlborough.
verified_facts.excerpt: Beautifully situated in the former manor home of the third Duke of Marlborough

verified_facts.text: The Grade II-listed gardens were re-designed in the 18th century by Lancelot 'Capability' Brown.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Grade II-listed gardens were re-designed in the 18th century by Lancelot ‘Capability’ Brown.

verified_facts.text: Guest rooms and suites are in the sensitively restored Palladian-style mansion house and the adjoining Grade II-listed Brew House.
verified_facts.excerpt: Sensitively restored, the Palladian-style mansion house and adjoining Grade-II listed Brew House

verified_facts.text: The rooms and suites were designed by Dennis Irvine studio.
verified_facts.excerpt: rooms and suites, designed by Dennis Irvine studio

verified_facts.text: Rooms feature roll-top baths, and expansive suites have grand windows.
verified_facts.excerpt: Dignified roll-top baths steal the show and expansive suites with grand windows frame the picturesque

verified_facts.text: Baroque fireplaces and ornate doorways have been re-established in the main house.
verified_facts.excerpt: Baroque fireplaces and ornate doorways have been painstakingly re-established in the main house.

verified_facts.text: Rooms in the Brew House, a Grade II-listed outbuilding, reflect former owners who brewed their own ferments.
verified_facts.excerpt: In the Grade II listed outbuilding, the Brew House, characterful rooms reflect the playful nature of former owners who brewed their own ferments.

verified_facts.text: The Duke of Marlborough Suite, the former room of the third Duke, overlooks the grounds and the lake, with an adjoining living room, three bedrooms and Athenian marble bathrooms.
verified_facts.excerpt: Overlooking the grounds and the lake, the Duke of Marlborough Suite comprises a prestigious adjoining living room, three beautifully presented bedrooms, and Athenian marble bathrooms.

verified_facts.text: The Langley Spa is described as one of Europe's largest indoor spas in a hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Langley Spa, one of Europe’s largest indoor spas in a hotel

verified_facts.text: The spa's thermal facilities and custom treatments are influenced by the restorative properties of the surrounding Buckinghamshire countryside.
verified_facts.excerpt: complemented by a plethora of thermal facilities and a menu of custom treatments, influenced by the restorative properties of the surrounding Buckinghamshire countryside

verified_facts.text: The spa's private VIP Suite has a relaxation space, vitality pool, juniper sauna and amethyst crystal steam room.
verified_facts.excerpt: complete with a relaxation space, vitality pool, juniper sauna and amethyst crystal steam room

verified_facts.text: The spa has authentic hammams where body rituals are performed.
verified_facts.excerpt: Discover our range of body rituals performed in our authentic Hammams.

verified_facts.text: The hotel has an indoor and an outdoor pool, a thermal area and fitness programs.
verified_facts.excerpt: along with an indoor and outdoor pool, a thermal area, fitness programs, and healthful dining selections

verified_facts.text: Each room includes access to the spa thermal facilities and gym.
verified_facts.excerpt: Each room in our Buckinghamshire accommodation includes access to our spa thermal facilities and gym

verified_facts.text: The spa has a beauty and grooming space with manicures, pedicures and a hair and beauty salon.
verified_facts.excerpt: A stunning space offering manicure and pedicure treatments alongside a hair and beauty salon

verified_facts.text: Through expert partners, the concierge can arrange falconry, horse riding in Windsor Great Park and polo lessons.
verified_facts.excerpt: from falconry on an English estate, to horse riding in Windsor Great Park and learning how to play polo

verified_facts.text: The grounds are the historic former royal hunting grounds of the third Duke of Marlborough.
verified_facts.excerpt: Discover the historic former royal hunting grounds of the third Duke of Marlborough.

verified_facts.text: The Head Concierge and his Les Clefs d'Or team can help create a bespoke itinerary.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our Head Concierge and his Les Clefs d'or team members provide a wealth of information to all guests visiting The Langley and can help to create a bespoke itinerary.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is near Windsor Castle.
verified_facts.excerpt: Discover history and nature near our hotel near Windsor Castle

verified_facts.text: Langley Park is within a short car or train journey from central London.
verified_facts.excerpt: Look out to the picuresque surroundings of Langley Park, all found within a short car or train journey from central London.

verified_facts.text: Langley Railway Station on the Elizabeth line is listed as a nearby station.
verified_facts.excerpt: Langley Railway Station (Elizabeth line)

verified_facts.text: Heathrow is the closest airport, approximately 12.2 km from the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: The closest airport near The Langley, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Buckinghamshire is Heathrow Airport (LHR). LHR is located approximately 12.2 KM from the hotel.

verified_facts.text: Cedar, the fine-dining restaurant, serves European cuisine with Spanish, French and Italian influences, using ingredients from local suppliers.
verified_facts.excerpt: Cedar at The Langley captures the spirit of European cuisine, featuring many influences from Spain, France and the best of Italian flavours at its heart. All ingredients in our fine-dining restaurant

verified_facts.text: Afternoon tea is served in the Drawing Room; it and Cedar have terraces overlooking the lake and estate grounds.
verified_facts.excerpt: quintessential afternoon tea is served in the exquisite Drawing Room. Both offer elegant outdoor settings, with terraces that overlook the sparkling lake and estate grounds

verified_facts.text: The Churchill Bar offers fine spirits, cognac and cocktails, with cigars stored in a custom humidor.
verified_facts.excerpt: a curated selection of fine spirits, cognac and cocktails, alongside a rare choice of cigars stored in a custom humidor

verified_facts.text: Connecting rooms and suites suit families, with children's robes, slippers and bathroom amenities.
verified_facts.excerpt: Relax into our expansive connecting rooms and suites, perfect for families including children's robes, slippers and bathroom amenities.

verified_facts.text: Babysitting can be arranged on request through the concierge.
verified_facts.excerpt: Baby sitting services can be arranged on request with our Concierge.
